package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "math/big"
    "os"
    "reflect"
    "sort"
)

func decode(data []byte) (any, error) {
    decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
    decoder.UseNumber()
    var value any
    err := decoder.Decode(&value)
    return value, err
}

func differences(left, right any, path string, out *[]string) {
    if len(*out) >= 20 { return }
    if a, ok := left.(json.Number); ok {
        if b, ok := right.(json.Number); ok {
            ar, aok := new(big.Rat).SetString(string(a))
            br, bok := new(big.Rat).SetString(string(b))
            if aok && bok && ar.Cmp(br) == 0 { return }
        }
    }
    if a, ok := left.(map[string]any); ok {
        if b, ok := right.(map[string]any); ok {
            keys := make([]string, 0, len(a)+len(b))
            for key := range a { keys = append(keys, key) }
            for key := range b { if _, exists := a[key]; !exists { keys = append(keys, key) } }
            sort.Strings(keys)
            for _, key := range keys {
                av, ae := a[key]; bv, be := b[key]
                switch {
                case !ae: *out = append(*out, fmt.Sprintf("%s[%q]: added %v", path, key, bv))
                case !be: *out = append(*out, fmt.Sprintf("%s[%q]: missing (was %v)", path, key, av))
                default: differences(av, bv, fmt.Sprintf("%s[%q]", path, key), out)
                }
                if len(*out) >= 20 { return }
            }
            return
        }
    }
    if a, ok := left.([]any); ok {
        if b, ok := right.([]any); ok && len(a) == len(b) {
            for i := range a { differences(a[i], b[i], fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", path, i), out) }
            return
        }
    }
    if !reflect.DeepEqual(left, right) {
        *out = append(*out, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v (%T) -> %v (%T)", path, left, left, right, right))
    }
}

func main() {
    result := map[string]any{}
    input, err := os.ReadFile("input.json")
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    var root Root
    err = json.Unmarshal(input, &root)
    if err != nil {
        result["unmarshalError"] = err.Error()
    } else {
        output, err := json.Marshal(root)
        if err != nil {
            result["marshalError"] = err.Error()
        } else {
            before, err := decode(input); if err != nil { panic(err) }
            after, err := decode(output); if err != nil { panic(err) }
            diffs := []string{}
            differences(before, after, "$", &diffs)
            result["roundTripDifferences"] = diffs
            if len(diffs) > 0 { result["roundTripOutput"] = string(output) }
        }
    }
    data, err := json.Marshal(result); if err != nil { panic(err) }
    fmt.Println(string(data))
}
